message.title: Telenor Sverige completes acquisition of a controlling stake in Bahnhof and makes a mandatory cash offer to the remaining shareholders
message.body:
Telenor Sverige completes acquisition of a controlling stake in Bahnhof and makes an unconditional mandatory cash offer of SEK 62 per share to the remaining shareholders.

For further information about the offer, please visit:
https://telecom-offer.com/en

and Telenor Sweden's newsroom:
https://www.telenor.se/press/
